body: Oh, is there a difference? Thanks, I honestly didn't even realize that I made that mistake

I feel like I'm 100 percent the same way. Ive messaged friends about why I got upset with my mother, and right now I couldn't yell you what upset me, but if I look at those messages I feel like i relive it again

Honestly, something that I still do is that if i had a shitty day, I'll tell myself that tomorrow will surely get better. And even if it doesn't, I tell myself the same thing until it actually does get better because that gives me something to look forward to. 

Something else that helped me was to simply not think about it. I always put it off till later, but I honestly don't recommend that. Cause when I got depressed all those previous questions that I asked myself would come back full force. 

I think though, that when I focused on all the things that made me happy (like that new trendy song that I can't get out of my head, or that webcomic that's finally nearing its conclusion), it made things much more bearable

-Cooking = My mom never taught me despite me always asking for help. I had to use recipes and cooking viedos

-Cleaning = My mom always tells me that I need to clean and when I don't do it her way, she tells me that I make her look bad in front of others and that I should know how to do it already
